design: Per-thread non-cyclic SQLite owner closes on that same thread exit without relying on cyclic GC or cross-thread close.
Governed close releases current thread SQLite connection; durable cache and remaining live subscriber can reopen their thread handles.
Injected portable caches remain caller-owned; wrap_backend explicitly owns its unique portable cache.
RecordingBackend defaults to caller-owned inner backend; CLI-owned chains opt into exactly-once inner close.
limits: Linux /proc file descriptor measurements. No scheduler, network or performance throughput claim.
Wall times are regression durations under concurrent work, not controlled latency measurements.
